message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a stainless steel equipment stand for restaurant kitchens. The likely classification is 9403.20.0090, other metal furniture, though 9403.20.0020 for "Other: Other" could also apply. Let me recall the subheadings.

HTSUS 9403.20: "Other metal furniture":
- 9403.20.0010 – Luggage racks, hotel (?), 
- 9403.20.0020 – Other: Tables (? ) 
- 9403.20.0030 – Other: Other... 

More precisely, 9403.20.00 includes: 9403.20.0010 Barbecue/…? I recall 9403.20.0010 as "Bed frames" (heading 9403.20.0010 under "Other metal furniture": Of aluminum?). The older structure is: 9403.20.0010 Luggage racks, bed frames, etc.; 9403.20.0020 Other: Furniture designed for use in a bathroom (?); 9403.20.0030 Other: Other: Baby changing...; 9403.20.0050 Other, Of a kind used in offices; 9403.20.0080 Other: Other (hmm); 9403.20.0090 Other: Other.

The current structure: 9403.20.0010 Luggage racks, bed frames, ... ; 9403.20.0020 Other: Furniture designed for non-domestic use? ; 9403.20.0030 Other: Other: Tables? I'm not sure. I believe 9403.20.0050 is "Other: Other: Shelving units", 9403.20.0080 is "Other: Other: Other: Of a kind used in nondomestic establishments"? I can't confirm.

I'll go with 9403.20.0090 as the general "Other" for metal furniture.
